profile.headline: Software Engineer @ JPMC | Backend & Data Systems | Model Deployment & ML Infrastructure | Python, AWS
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer working in ML infrastructure within the CCB Risk domain at JPMorganChase focused on building systems that support model deployment, evaluation, and reliability at scale.

I’ve worked on a model output evaluation tool that compares outputs across model versions to validate changes from feature engineering or code updates. This work feeds into a broader ML deployment system built on a control plane / data plane architecture, where I’ve contributed to API development, system design, and event-driven integrations.

My experience includes building backend services utilizing API and event based messaging, and working with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Terraform) to support scalable, production-ready systems. I’ve also contributed to orchestration workflows that coordinate automated model testing and validation after changes are introduced.

More recently, I’ve been focused on AI-assisted development—using tools like GitHub Copilot and exploring integrations with systems like Jira and Bitbucket via MCP to create more context-aware, agentic engineering workflows.

I’m particularly interested in ML systems and backend infrastructure—where models meet production—and in building reliable, scalable platforms that enable intelligent applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
CCB Risk – ML Delivery Team

- Contributed to a model output comparator tool that analyzes differences between model versions to validate changes from feature engineering and code updates, improving confidence in deployment readiness

- Contributed to a broader ML deployment platform built on a control plane / data plane architecture, supporting scalable and reliable model rollout workflows

- Designed and developed backend APIs to support model deployment and evaluation workflows, enabling integration across multiple services within the platform

- Implemented event-driven communication patterns to coordinate model testing and validation processes across distributed components

- Developed and maintained cloud-based infrastructure using AWS Lambda and Terraform to support scalable, production-ready services

- Contributed to orchestration workflows that automate model testing following code or data changes, reducing manual validation effort

- Participated in system design and implementation of backend services supporting data processing and model lifecycle management

- Leveraged AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and explored integrations with systems like Jira and Bitbucket via MCP to improve development efficiency and context-aware workflows
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +3 skills
